data.title: Analyst Tate Sullivan Raises FEAM Price Target to $5.00 and Reiterates Buy on Searles Valley Acquisition-Driven EBITDA Turnaround
data.description:
Maxim Group analyst Tate Sullivan has maintained their bullish stance on FEAM stock, giving a Buy rating on October 6.

Tate Sullivan has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to FEAM’s acquisition of Searles Valley Minerals and the resulting earnings outlook. He sees a credible path from near-term EBITDA losses to meaningful, positive EBITDA over the next few years, supported by higher contract pricing and expanding production volumes that materially lift revenue forecasts.

At the same time, Sullivan notes that FEAM acquired valuable processing infrastructure and long‑term borate resources at a relatively modest purchase price, without assuming the seller’s sizable environmental liabilities. Using a sum‑of‑the‑parts and discounted cash flow framework with a higher price target of $5.00, he concludes that the improved cash‑flow profile and asset base justify a Buy rating despite the need for additional capital and ongoing development spending.

He sees Snowflake as well aligned to benefit from enterprise AI adoption, with the CoCo platform already driving meaningful engagement and poised to support accelerating consumption trends over the coming quarters.
